messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: document management system (Sat 13 Dec)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's DMS will be unavailable on Saturday 13 December from 07:00 to 13:00 GMT for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save any in-progress documents locally before the window. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
